description.value: Big Orange is a BC-born bubble tea franchise that launched at Metrotown Mall in Burnaby in 1996 and has grown to more than 20 locations across Canada, the US, and Malaysia. This Metrotown unit — the original flagship store — offers fresh fruit bubble teas, smoothies, slushes, ice cream drinks, Belgium waffles, and freshly squeezed juices. Located inside the mall at level 1, it makes a convenient refreshment stop for cyclists passing through Burnaby's commercial core.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 6m; stands at 11m; stands at 72m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places a Big Orange bubble tea cafe (amenity=cafe, takeaway=yes, level=1) at coordinates that map to the Metrotown Mall area of Burnaby; the website's /locations/ page lists the Metrotown Mall location as 'E8A-4700 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 4M1', confirming the match. The brand's site is active through 2026 (app launched March 2026, copyright 2026) with no indication of store closures, though a 2020 COVID notice for the corporate office appears on all pages. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeaway is confirmed by both the OSM tag and the brand's product offerings.
concerns: OSM record contains no address; address derived from coordinates matching the Metrotown Mall, Burnaby entry on the website's /locations/ page — should be verified on-site.
Phone 604-438-5779 is from the corporate/franchise contact page, not a store-specific line; OSM carried no phone number.
OSM level=1 tag indicates an upper-floor mall unit, which may require elevator or escalator access — relevant for cyclists with loaded bikes.
Recurring 'NOTICE OF TEMPORARY OFFICE CLOSURE – COVID-19 EFFECTIVE MONDAY MARCH 16, 2020' on all pages refers to the corporate office, not retail stores, but may confuse readers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Big Orange is a real, active bubble tea franchise with a confirmed Metrotown Mall location; the brand website is current through 2026 with no evidence of store-level closures.

wow_evidence: more than 20 locations across Canada, the US, and Malaysia
